name: Suffren-class (Barracuda) SSN, drawn as Suffren (S635)

published.source: en.wikipedia 'Suffren-class submarine' (raw wikitext read 2026-11-12, js/hero/fr_navy_late.js header): 99.5 x 8.8 m, draught 7.3 m

references.name: [U1] Suffren class SSN.svg, starboard profile
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'Suffren class SSN.svg' (en.wikipedia), rendered 1600 px
references.note: Cone tip px 1 to bow px 1599 = the published 99.5 m (16.08 px/m); the keel row 352 is the drawing's lower edge, the waterline put the published 7.3 m draught above it: X = px / 16.08 - 49.75, Z = (352 - py) / 16.08 - 7.3. Read by a column scan of the alpha: hull top 2.15 (row 200) and keel -7.3 amidships; the knuckle line (heavy line) row 237 px 250..1355; sail after edge px 955 (casing) to 1003 (top), top row 97 (8.56) falling to 8.0 at the front, front upright at px 1191, fillet to the casing at px 1250; masts to rows 51 / 2 / 3; X fins px 100..167, tips rows 213 / 351 (4.3 m off the axis row 282 in profile); shroud px 21..83, rows 245..320 at its front. Panel lines and sail windows are on the drawing; no markings.

references.name: [U2] Suffren at Cape Brun off Toulon, 26 July 2020
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'Suffren at Cape Brun off Toulon on 26 July 2020.jpg'
references.note: For the reviewer: the boat surfaced at long range, starboard side: the low casing, the upright-fronted sail with its fillet, the black finish. Too small to scale.

must_show: a long body of revolution, 99.3 m (cone tip X -49.7 to bow X +49.7), 8.8 m beam, hull top 2.15 m and keel -7.3 m amidships [U1], the bow a full round
the casing on the hull's back from the knuckle at z -0.15 (X -34.2 .. 34.5) to a flat top 2.15 m up, about 5 m wide, sides sloping in; a low walking ridge beyond
sail X 9.6 .. 24.3, top 8.5 m: raked after edge (X 9.6 at the casing, 12.6 at the top), upright front at X 24.3, its top rounded off
the fillet at the sail's forward foot curving down from z 4.1 at X 24.3 to the casing at X 28.0 (z 2.9 at X 26.0)
three masts raised over the sail: two square optronic masts X 19.3 and 20.3 to 14.5 / 14.4 (lower stages 0.9 m square to 11.4 / 12.2), the third X 15.4 to 11.4
windows on the sail's sides X 21.9 .. 22.6 at z 4.8 - 5.4 and X 19.0 .. 20.1 at 7.25 - 7.6, the door at the foot X 21.6 .. 22.6, the navigation lights at X 22.6, z 7.6; ladder rungs up the side
X tail: four fins at 45 deg, X -43.5 .. -39.4 at the root, reaching 6.1 m off the axis (z -2.95), the upper tips standing out of the water (z 1.34 at X -42.5), each with its flap slot at X -42.4
pump-jet: a revolved shroud X -48.4 .. -44.6, radius 1.80 aft to 2.33 forward, on stator vanes round the tail cone, the cone's tip at X -49.7

the long slotted panel low on each side X 0.6 .. 35.1, z -2.2 .. -5.0, with its slots; limber-hole columns at X -33.9, 34.1, 41.5 and rows of holes along the casing's side X -32.9 .. -1.6, 28.6 .. 33.6
casing fittings: cleats at X -30.5, 5.0, 35.1; round hatches at X -24, -8, 30.5; the weapons-loading hatch X 36.5; the safety track along the crown; the bow-plane housings X 44.3 .. 45.8, z -1.8

anechoic tile finish (staggered 0.5 m tiles, odd replaced and missing ones) on hull, casing and sail; matt black; no numbers or markings; team colour only as small strips on the sail top (X 13 .. 15.5) and the casing abaft it
